runs.title: Macy's parade postponed: the new date and why
runs.prompt: For the first time in its history, the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade in New York City has been postponed because of severe weather — it was due to happen on Thursday 27 November 2026. Find out from a public, non-paywalled source: (1) the new date and time the parade will now take place, (2) the specific weather reason given for the postponement (wind/rain etc.), and (3) whether the giant balloons are still expected to fly. Give the answer and name the source you used. Start with these pages and follow links if needed.
runs.answer: Macy's postponed its 100th Thanksgiving Day Parade (originally Thursday 27 Nov 2026) to Saturday 28 November 2026 at 8:30 a.m. ET. The stated reason was a powerful coastal storm expected to hit New York on Thanksgiving with heavy rain and thunderstorms, wind gusts up to 65 mph and flash flooding; Macy's said the move was made "due to expected severe weather" with participant and spectator safety as the top priority. The giant balloons are still expected to fly — the wind had raised concerns about their safety, but Mayor Zohran Mamdani said that "on Saturday, when balloons climb into the sky," the full show will go on. Source used: CBS News New York (cbsnews.com/newyork), corroborated by CNBC; the AP link was blocked by a bot wall.

runs.title: Florida Thanksgiving poisoning: the numbers
runs.prompt: A Thanksgiving meal in Florida on 26-27 November 2026 led to a mass food-poisoning ('mass casualty') incident. From public, non-paywalled sources, find out: (1) how many people fell ill and how many were hospitalised, (2) where in Florida this happened, and (3) what the suspected cause or food item was, if officials have said. Keep it factual and include the source name for each fact.
runs.answer: (1) 18 people fell ill and 15 were hospitalised, which led Miami-Dade Fire Rescue to upgrade the call to a "Level Three Mass Casualty Incident" (CBS Miami; The Guardian, citing the Miami Herald, also gives 18 ill / 15 hospitalised). (2) It happened at the Leon Medical Centers headquarters building at 8600 NW 41st Street in Doral, Florida (Miami-Dade County, about 12 miles northwest of downtown Miami) — not at one of its patient care facilities (CBS Miami; The Guardian). (3) No cause or specific food item has been officially identified: Leon Medical Centers said it had contracted an external caterer for the staff Thanksgiving luncheon, that staff developed gastrointestinal symptoms shortly after, and that it is "work[ing] with the caterers to determine, if possible, the cause," while fire rescue released no information on the cause (CBS Miami; The Guardian). Note the lunch itself was held Wednesday 25 November 2026, with the incident and coverage reported 26–27 November; no patients at the center were affected.

runs.title: Davis Cup semi-final: Italy result
runs.prompt: Italy played the Czech Republic in a Davis Cup semi-final around 26-27 November 2026. Find the result — final scoreline and which tie matches decided it — and confirm whether Italy advanced to the final. Use a public tennis or sports source and cite it.
runs.answer: Italy beat the Czech Republic 2–1 in the Davis Cup semifinal on 27 November 2026 at the SuperTennis Arena (Unipol Hall) in Bologna. Lorenzo Musetti opened with a 6–3, 6–4 win over Jakub Menšík; Jiří Lehečka levelled by beating Flavio Cobolli 6–2, 1–6, 6–3; the tie was then decided in the third and final rubber, the doubles, where Musetti and Andrea Vavassori beat Lehečka and Tomáš Macháč 3–6, 6–1, 7–6 (third-set tiebreak). Italy therefore advanced to the final, where they face the winner of the second semifinal, Great Britain vs Spain.
